title: Correcting Within-Group Self-Selection Bias in Prioritized Replay
abstract: arXiv:2609.25297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prioritized experience replay (PER) improves sample efficiency by replaying high-priority transitions, usually according to absolute temporal-difference error. In stochastic environments, PER can distort the distribution of realized outcomes replayed from transitions with the same state-action pair. We call this within-group self-selection. We quantify the resulting changes in within-group outcome frequencies and mean Bellman targets. We decompose PER into between-group allocation and conditional sibling selection, and derive fixed-buffer corrections that preserve current group-level priority mass: SAMPLE selects a group through PER and trains on a uniformly sampled sibling; AVG averages sibling Bellman targets; and MODEL samples from an empirical full-outcome model. translated_title: 校正优先级重放中的组内自选择偏差
translated_abstract: 优先级经验回放（PER）通过回放高优先级转移来提高样本效率，通常依据的是绝对时间差分误差。在随机环境中，PER可能会扭曲从具有相同状态-动作对的转移中回放出的实际结果分布，我们将这种现象称为组内自选择。我们量化了由此导致的组内结果频率与平均Bellman目标的变化。我们将PER分解为组间分配与条件性兄弟选择，并推导出保持当前组级优先级质量不变的固定缓冲区校正方法：SAMPLE通过PER选择一个组，并在均匀采样的兄弟转移上训练；AVG对兄弟转移的Bellman目标取平均；MODEL则从经验性的全结果模型中采样。在存在罕见大幅值结果的精确状态-动作环境中，感知兄弟信息的重放相比PER提升了学习效率，尽管匹配的参数扫描表明（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文揭示了优先级经验回放在随机环境中因“组内自选择”导致的偏差，并提出三种保持组级优先级质量的校正方法（SAMPLE、AVG、MODEL），在罕见大幅值结果场景下显著提升学习效率。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the within-group self-selection bias in prioritized experience replay under stochasticity and proposes three fixed-buffer corrections (SAMPLE, AVG, MODEL) that preserve group-level priority mass, improving learning efficiency with rare high-magnitude outcomes.
